fixes.explanation: Jesus tells Sardis, “you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.” A reputation is what a church is known for, and for Sardis that was being alive. I've seen cookies that looked golden and finished on the cooling rack and were still doughy inside, so I know how looks can fool you. Jesus sees past the outside.

Jesus says, “What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.” Nobody can overrule that key. Once He opens a door, it stays open. A drawer somebody else closed had me for years, so that line stands out to me.

Warns isn't the word in this verse. Jesus says those liars will come and bow down at the church's feet, and what they come to know is His love for Philadelphia. Just before this, He says the church has only a little strength (Revelation 3:8). So this verse gives them something to lean on, not a scolding. Good guess, friend, but the word is loves.
